parse.title: Spirit Sniper
parse.text:
Overview

Spirit Sniper is a MythicalMythical Limited unit based on Chika Amatori from the anime World Trigger.

She is only obtainable once you get to rank 25 in Trion Hunt Battlepass and buying Premium Pass for her shiny version.

Evolving

Spirit Sniper can evolve into Spirit Sniper (Prodigy) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Spirit Sniper

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
